measurement: Subthreshold passive load at 110 pA (sweep 43, no spike in either): rest before the pulse, plateau 1800-2000 ms, onset capacitance from the first 1 ms after the step.
model_trace: h01-e-sahp-tail/s1-ksahp-tail5-sweep43.npz (the 5 s KsAHP gate is silent without a spike, so this trace is B3's passive response; it matches g0-b3's onset rows to 0.000 mV)
reading: The human cell's passive load is 13 percent more conductance and 3 percent more capacitance than B3's, with a 1 ms shorter time constant. This is the observable range of the input for this pair: any claim that the cable load explains a model-human difference must do it with about a 1.13x load change, not more.
